title: Criminal Background — Police Clearance
clarification: Costa Rica requires an official police clearance certificate from the country of nationality and recent residence.

criteria: Properly legalized or apostilled if required

handling.no_criminal_record: If no criminal record exists, the certificate serves as proof of a clean record.
handling.criminal_record_disclosed: If a criminal record exists (including misdemeanors), the certificate provides the factual basis used by immigration authorities for discretionary review.

boundary.case_by_case_review: Costa Rica evaluates criminal background information on a case-by-case basis and does not publish a list of acceptable or unacceptable offenses.
boundary.legal_deferral: If a criminal record exists, legal guidance from an immigration attorney is required to assess how it may affect eligibility.
